name: Dominate (Dark Ages) — 1 Basic — Murmur of the False Will

system.description:
You can implant an order in the mind of another — a direct command, instructions for an eventuality, or even an idea that will color her behavior — and the target will act on it to the best of her ability. Its execution depends on the target's comprehension, so simplicity and clarity are important.

You must win a Mental Challenge against your target. You can then instruct her with any command, immediate, cued to occur later, or planted as a subconscious idea. If the command is immediately hazardous to the target, she need not obey it. Unless subterfuge or additional powers are used, the target will remember the placement of the order. A person can hold only one Murmur of the False Will at a time; giving new instructions before the first is completed erases the first command.
